_instructions: TEMPLATE for AI agents: fill in this JSON to build a quiz for quiz-maker.html.
1. meta.interface = 'ku' (Kurdish UI only), 'en' (English UI only), or 'both' (language switch).
2. Every text field has a Kurdish base key and an English '_en' key. You may fill only one language; the other falls back automatically.
3. meta.title / meta.title_en: quiz name shown at the top. meta.slug: output filename (optional).
4. meta.subtitle / subtitle_en: one line under the title (optional).
5. meta.intro / intro_en: optional list of extra bullet lines for the start screen (question counts are added automatically).
6. questions: array. Each item has category/category_en, question/question_en, options/options_en, correct (0-based index), explanation/explanation_en.
7. options and options_en must be the same length and same order; 'correct' points into that order.
8. Remove this '_instructions' key when you are done (optional but cleaner).
